lesson.menu_desc: Trials for the interschool team, and a lot of gossip -- he said it was, she told me she would -- 28 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 21 -- Who Said What?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Renato | Lesson 21 -- Who Said What?
lesson.grammar_point: reported speech (said / told somebody + that, with the verb one step back: is -> was, can -> could, will -> would)

listenings.text: Okay, listen up, everyone. There is a lot of gossip about the trials, so here are the facts. The trials are next Saturday, not this Saturday. Next Saturday, at our home beach, at seven. The coach is Dana Reid. She works with the state team, and she picks the interschool squad. Not me. I just surf, like you. The squad has four surfers and one reserve. Everybody gets two heats of twenty minutes, and she watches all of them. Some of you asked me if you need a new board. No. Surf your normal board. And one more thing: I will announce the names on Monday, on the club group, not before. So please, stop asking me. I don't know. Nobody knows. Just surf well.

Hey, Renato, it's Millie. So, your mum called our house last night because your phone was off. Mum talked to her for like an hour. Your mum said she was really proud of you. She told Mum that you trained every day in Brazil and that you never missed a comp. She also said you were nervous before big heats, and that you always ate a banana before you paddled out. Mum laughed so much. Oh, and Mum said she could drive you to the trials on Saturday, and she told me she wanted to stay and watch. So, sorry, you have a fan on the beach. Also, Dad said he would make pancakes for you before the trials. Okay, that's all the news. Call your mum!

items.situation: Kai said: "The trials are next Saturday." Your host mum asks what Kai said. Tell her.
Harper told you: "I can't come to training on Thursday." Kai asks where Harper is. Report it.
Ollie said: "I will help on the sand." A teammate asks if Ollie is coming. Report it.
Now you are the captain. A grommet heard a rumor. Tell him what the coach really said.
You call your mum in Brazil. Tell her two things Kai said about the trials, and one thing Bev said.
